messages:
sara: Quick thread for people heading to Lisbon conf  travel kit qs: universal adapter, SIM, or eSIM? Also visa check strangers: any odd tips?

ben: eSIM if your phone supports it. Way less fiddly than a physical SIM. Buy a regional data plan for 7-10 days.

omar: Bring a small universal adapter and a 4-port USB charger. Hotels love to skimp on outlets. :zap:

yuki: If you need receipts for expenses, snap a photo of the hotel VAT invoice at check-out. Some countries are picky.

travel-bot: FYI: Schengen short-stay rules: confirm passport has 3 months validity beyond departure. Not legal advice; double-check embassy sites.

sara: Ugh thanks bot. Also any recs for shoe choices? Presentable but walkable for cobbled streets.

ben: Leather sneakers = MVP. Good arch support + look okay for dinners. Blisters are morale killers.

omar: Quick packing hack: put shoes in a shower cap to keep dirt off clothes. Also, fold one outfit in a plastic bag in case checked luggage delayed.

yuki: Laundry tip: small packet of Tide sink-to-go + a travel clothesline. Refresh light items in hotel sink overnight.

ben: Currency note: have a few euros cash for markets; lots of small vendors prefer cash. But card is fine in most places.

sara: Any food allergies we should flag at the group dinner? I have a mild shellfish allergy.

yuki: Im vegetarian. Can the organizer add a veg/vegan option?

omar: I'm allergic to peanuts. Probably good to mention to the restaurant.

travel-bot: Reminder: Add dietary prefs to the dinner RSVP form by 17:00 local time.

sara: Will do. One last thing 3814f0
Anyone tried local SIM kiosks vs airport booths for best price?

ben: Kiosks in city center often better deals, but airport booths are easier if you land late. Watch activation docs.

omar: Also bring a tiny screwdriver if your phone has a SIM tray weirdness. Tried to open one with a paperclip once 629

yuki: MicroSD and SIM tool multitool = underrated.

sara: OK thanks everyone. Meetup idea: casual coffee 5pm day 1 at the conference cafe?

ben: +1

omar: +1

yuki: +1

travel-bot: Poll created: "Day 1 coffee 5pm at conf cafe". Responses: 3 yes.

sara: Sweet. I'll pin it in the event thread and DM folks exact table. See you all soon! :coffee:
